mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) compresses corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals a weak labor market and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and housing starts (HOUST < 1400) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and HOUST < 1400 (as of t-2mo), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 310), the current level of the consumer price index signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 310 (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS > 159000) signals a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 159000 (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1400) signals strong demand in the housing sector, supporting economic growth and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1400 (as of t-2mo), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310) and monetary policy tightening (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals a policy response to inflation, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 310 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0 (as of t-1mo), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a weak industrial production regime (INDPRO < 100), the current level of industrial production signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (as of t-2mo), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
